title: Population estimates comparison
code: datasus_pop_uf <- uf_pop_totals(source = "datasus") |>   mutate(source = "DataSUS") |>   filter(uf != "5e") #> Setting `max_tries = 2`. #> Setting `max_tries = 2`.  ufrn_pop_uf <- uf_pop_totals(source = "ufrn") |>   mutate(source = "UFRN") #> Setting `max_tries = 2`. #> Setting `max_tries = 2`.  ibge_pop_uf <- uf_pop_totals(source = "ibge") |>   mutate(source = "IBGE")  datasus2024_pop_uf <- uf_pop_totals(source = "datasus2024") |>   mutate(source = "DataSUS 2024") #> Setting `max_tries = 2`. #> Setting `max_tries = 2`.  bind_rows(datasus_pop_uf, ufrn_pop_uf, ibge_pop_uf, datasus2024_pop_uf) |>   left_join(names_helper, by = c("uf" = "uf_code")) |>   ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pop, color = source, group = source)) +   geom_line(stat = "identity", alpha = .7, lwd = 1) +   geom_vline(     xintercept = c(2000, 2010, 2022),     alpha = .5,     linetype = "longdash"   ) +   scale_y_continuous(     labels = unit_format(accuracy = 1, scale = 0.00001, unit = NULL)   ) +   facet_wrap(~uf_name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +   theme_bw() +   theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "horizontal") +   labs(     title = "Population estimates per UF from different sources",     subtitle = "in 100,000 units",     color = "Source",     x = "Year",     y = "Population estimate"   )

title: Municipality population from IBGE, 2000 to 2025 — ibge_pop
text: Census values 2000 2010 come SIDRA table 202, 2022 values come SIDRA table 9514. 2007 population count comes SIDRA table 793. Annual estimates 2001–2006, 2008–2009, 2011–2021 come SIDRA table 6579, updated 2024-06-24. Values 2023 population figures sent TCU using 2022 Census 2023 territorial grid, available IBGE 2023 download directory. Values 2024 come estimates published DOU. Values 2025 use revised estimates sent TCU 2026-01-13. source workbooks available IBGE download directories 2024 2025. ibge_pop() bundled package require Internet access. return structure remains compatible previous releases.

title: brpop 0.7.0
text: Add revised 2025 IBGE municipal population estimates sent TCU 2026-01-13, preserving 2000–2024 values established code_muni, year, pop columns.
